package recording_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	binding "example.test/generated/api/go/history-binding"
	protocol "example.test/generated/api/go/history-protocol"
	"github.com/Bitspark/nightseam/duplex/go"
	"github.com/Bitspark/nightseam/runtime/go"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type cancelledHead struct {
	*duplex.MemoryWireLog
	entered chan struct{}
}

func (log *cancelledHead) Head(ctx context.Context) (uint64, error) {
	close(log.entered)
	<-ctx.Done()
	return 0, ctx.Err()
}

func TestCancelledHeadDetachesGeneratedPreparation(t *testing.T) {
	target, values := target(t)
	log := &cancelledHead{duplex.NewMemoryWireLog(), make(chan struct{})}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	go func() { <-log.entered; cancel() }()
	if _, err := binding.Record(ctx, target, log, duplex.RecordOptions{}, runtime.AdapterContext{}); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatalf("setup: %v", err)
	}
	ctx, stop := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer stop()
	store := duplex.NewMemoryWireLog()
	closed := make(chan struct{})
	recorder, err := binding.Record(ctx, target, store, duplex.RecordOptions{OnClose: func(error) { close(closed) }}, runtime.AdapterContext{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer recorder.Close(1000, "")
	if err := recorder.Append(ctx, binding.RecordedTick{Data: protocol.Payload{Value: 7}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	next(t, ctx, values, int64(7))
	if head, err := recorder.Head(ctx); err != nil || head != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("head %d %v", head, err)
	}
	if err := recorder.Close(1000, ""); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	select {
	case <-closed:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
	rebound, err := binding.Record(ctx, target, duplex.NewMemoryWireLog(), duplex.RecordOptions{}, runtime.AdapterContext{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("closed recorder retained its attachment or closed the borrowed target: %v", err)
	}
	defer rebound.Close(1000, "")
	if err := rebound.Append(ctx, binding.RecordedTick{Data: protocol.Payload{Value: 8}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	next(t, ctx, values, int64(8))
}
